create.name: Alison Armstrong
create.bio:
Alison Armstrong is an American educator who has spent more than thirty years studying how women and men misread one another and how they might become partners rather than opponents. Her starting point is a question she often puts to students: what if nobody is actually behaving badly, yourself included? After several years of informally researching men for her own sake, she created a workshop for women in 1995 and, with her friend Joan McClain, founded PAX Programs to teach the approach more widely; tens of thousands of people have since taken part.

Her curriculum now runs as a sequence of online courses and live intensives, beginning with Understanding Men and Understanding Women and moving on to love and commitment, intimacy, communication in conflict and what she calls being extraordinary as a man or a woman. The tone is practical and often funny, with an emphasis on honouring oneself first and then others. She is the author of The Queen's Code, a teaching novel about bringing out the best in men, records audiobooks and holds regular live question-and-answer sessions on her YouTube channel. She divides her time between northern Colorado and Idaho.

courses.title: Understanding Men and Understanding Women
courses.description: Her two foundation courses, taken online at your own pace. They explain the different ways men and women tend to think, act and talk, and how to bring out the best in each other; free samples are offered.

courses.title: Understanding Love & Commitment and Understanding Sex & Intimacy
courses.description: Follow-on online courses about how women and men experience commitment, marriage and closeness differently, and what that means for choosing and keeping a partner.

courses.title: LUX ~ Liberation. Understanding. Xtraordinary Relationships
courses.description: About seven hours of recorded teaching on the habits of listening and speaking that block connection, with bonus live calls and a private group. Access is sold for six or thirty days.

courses.title: Extreme Freedom
courses.description: Eight hours of self-paced video on letting go of old hurts and conclusions so that they stop deciding how you relate to others now.

courses.title: Smart Singles Intensive 2027
courses.description: A months-long programme for single people, limited to forty participants, combining her online courses with live Zoom classrooms led by Alison. Applications are open for the 2027 group.

courses.title: Being Extraordinary as a Man or Woman
courses.description: A programme on getting clear about who you are and what matters to you, and on spending your energy in ways that suit your nature rather than draining it.

courses.title: The Queen's Code (e-book and audiobook)
courses.description: Her teaching novel about the ways women and men unknowingly bring out the worst in one another, and a code of honour for changing that. Sold from her site as an e-book or as an audiobook she reads herself.

free_resources.title: Free Videos from Alison Armstrong
free_resources.description: A page of short free videos on everyday puzzles between men and women, such as why questions do not get men talking.

free_resources.title: Free Audio Recordings
free_resources.description: Free talks and interviews to listen to or download.
